https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399700/_/
The game is made by "YesYesPlay🏀🐔".
This is a one - person studio, and it's the producer's first officially launched work on STEAM.
The game pays tribute to and adopts many gameplay elements from 👻"Ghostrunner".
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1139900/

We hope everyone can have a 😍great time😍!!!!

notes.title: The parkour game "Parkour Assassin" is set to be launched on January 24th!
notes.content:
Cyberpunk-style action parkour game "Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run" is here!
The game is made by "YesYesPlay🏀🐔".
It's a one-person studio,
and this is the producer's first officially launched work on STEAM.
The game pays tribute to and adopts many gameplay elements from 👻"Ghostrunner".
You'll control a ninja running and parkouring through the city at night,
dodging dangers and taking out enemies in the way.

📍The STEAM version of the game is scheduled for release on January 24th at 17:00 (Beijing Time)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399700
📍It will be launched at a single-digit price.
📍Interested friends can add the game to your⭐ wishlist⭐
